answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint soft IDs that climb a trellis of cheap attest edges before stake settles. Mechanism: lock 0.29 POA in a 38h dune-escrow and gather three violet-tagged vouchers from invite-distance ≥2 peers; each H=sha256(epoch|addr|slot|salt) spaced 70–140s. Weight accrues only if ≥2 non-overlapping voucher lineages countersign distinct slots while the dune stays sealed. Cost: bond plus ~7 min peer clocks. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and three H digests ride the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, lineage overlap, or gap-cheat burns the dune and zeros that epoch weight.
